summary: AES Corp. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder votes at a special meeting held June 26, 2026, regarding the pending merger with Horizon Parent, L.P. Shareholders approved the merger agreement (479M for, 10M against), the nonbinding advisory compensation proposal, and no adjournment was needed. The vote is a procedural step in a previously announced merger, not an initiating event. This filing is a routine current report of shareholder meeting results, not a standalone special situation.
